g.text: Zero: Balochi, Talysh, Mazanderani, Gilaki, Gorani, Luri, Laki, Tajik, Zazaki
Tools: Persian has Hazm, DadmaTools and Parsivar; no equivalent exists for any other variety.
Treebanks: Persian UD, Kurmanji UD and Central Kurdish–Mukri only.
Persian has the text but only 273 paradigms; Kurmanji has 15,083.
